draft.content:
We provide the following records in response to this dispute. The customer claims to have been charged but cannot find any tickets or confirmation [case_atm_1044:dispute]. The payment was captured for order ATM-1044 [case_atm_1044:payment]. The order shows two tickets were issued to The Late Set [case_atm_1044:order]. Both tickets are recorded as issued in the system [case_atm_1044:ticket-1] [case_atm_1044:ticket-2]. No delivery records, acknowledgements, or scan data are available to confirm receipt or attendance. The available records establish that tickets were issued but cannot confirm they were delivered, read, or used.

SOURCE LIMITATIONS
- Missing delivery records to confirm ticket receipt channel and status
- Missing customer acknowledgements of ticket access
- Missing attendance or scan data to confirm usage
